svg.title: Osteoarthritis as a chronic monoarthritis: rule out red flags, make the clinical diagnosis, stage it on X-ray, then treat with biomechanical and education measures at every stage, medicines for symptoms, and joint replacement only for end-stage disease; arthroscopy is not recommended
